title: "Tayo Sa Wakas" leads as most-watched film on Netflix PH
summary: Star Cinema’s romantic drama film “Tayo Sa Wakas,” starring Donny Pangilinan and Belle Mariano, continues to dominate Netflix Philippines as the platform’s most-watched film.
